description:
Solve a multi-step constrained MPC problem on the server.

Use this when the horizon has soft state bounds, hard input and slew limits,
and an offset-free disturbance rejection term. Pass the same ``session_id``
on later calls of one closed loop so the shifted primal and dual warm start
is restored. Omit ``session_id`` for a single stateless solve.

Do not call this for a one-step linear update you can do locally (a matrix
multiply, a threshold, or reading a sensor). Those do not need IPOPT.
CasADi and IPOPT return u0 and the predicted trajectory for robotics,
energy storage, and process control. session_id is the warm start.

This is POST /v1/solve at $0.02. Send header X-API-Key when a $15 pack still
has solve credits. With no key, or when those credits are gone, the call is
HTTP 402 and an agent pays with x402. There is no second payment path.

Set ``reset_warm_start`` or call the ``reset_warm_start`` tool to drop the
seed for that session. The compiled solver stays. A reset only clears the
seed stored for the caller who owns it.

request.description: Paid constrained solve at $0.02. Send X-API-Key while the pack has solve credits, or pay HTTP 402 with x402 on Base USDC. Validate free first. Autotune is the later step when the weights are unknown.

Q.description: Stage state weight, shape nx by nx.

Qf.description: Terminal state weight, shape nx by nx.

R.description: Input weight, shape nu by nu.

Rd.description: Slew weight on delta-u, shape nu by nu.

U_ref.description: Input reference over the horizon, shape N by nu. Omit for the equilibrium input.

X_ref.description: State reference over the horizon, shape (N+1) by nx. Omit to hold x_ref.

actuator_delay_ms.description: Optional delay in milliseconds. Used only when actuator_delay_steps is 0. Converted with round(ms / (dt * 1000)) and clamped to 0..5.

actuator_delay_steps.description: Commands already in flight before the one being solved. 0 leaves the solve unchanged. Values outside 0..5 are clamped.

cmd_vel_frame_id.description: frame_id on TwistStamped exports. Default base_link. Letters, digits, underscore, slash, and hyphen only.

anyOf.description:
Allowlisted rows ``h(x, u, p) <= 0`` and fixed obstacle slots.

Soft rows use one slack per node. ``hard`` true removes those slacks.
A linear plant with any row here uses the nonlinear solver. The linear-only solver option is rejected.

h.description: Scalar rows, each h(x, u, p) <= 0. At most 8. Symbols are x[i], u[i], p[i], and pi. Same length, depth, and node caps as expression dynamics.

hard.description: True enforces the rows with no slack. Default false.

anyOf.description: At most eight circles. Their four numbers each sit outside ``np <= 8``.

position.description: Two distinct state indexes for the circle plane. Example: [0, 1].

slots.description: Circle slots. Length 1 to 8. Each is cx, cy, r, active.

items.description: One fixed circle. ``active`` is 0 or 1 and is not part of caller ``p``.

active.description: 1 keeps the circle. 0 drops the row. No other value is accepted.

cx.description: Center along the first position index, in the plant's state units.

cy.description: Center along the second position index, in the plant's state units.

obstacles.description: Fixed circles. Omit for none. The row is active * (r^2 - squared distance) <= 0.

p.description: Caller parameters for h, length 0 to 8. On an expression plant, omit this to use the plant p. Obstacle slots do not use this vector and do not count toward the cap.

slack_l1.description: L1 weight on each inequality slack. Omit for 1000. Ignored when hard is true.

slack_l2.description: L2 weight on each inequality slack. Omit for 100. Ignored when hard is true.

constraints.description: Optional h(x, u, p) <= 0 rows and fixed obstacle slots. Omit for none. Needs the nonlinear solver. The linear-only solver option is rejected.

corridor_half_width.description: Optional half-width, in meters, of a soft corridor around the reference heading. Omit to add no corridor slacks. Nodes k = 1..N stay within this lateral distance, with a non-negative slack so a start outside the tube stays feasible.

anyOf.description:
Path-frame and zone residuals. Economic prices stay the linear stage vectors.

``linear_state_cost`` and ``linear_input_cost`` are the economic term. They are
linear in the node. Path samples, zone centers, half-widths, and weights are
parameters of the compiled problem.

path.description: One path sample per state node, length N+1. Each sample is along, across, and heading, in the position indexes' units and the heading state's units.

anyOf.description: Squared path residuals. Heading uses both sin and 1 - cos.

heading.description: State index of the heading. Must differ from both position indexes.

heading_weight.description: Weight on both squared heading residuals, sin(heading error) and 1 - cos(heading error). Must be >= 0. Default 1. The two residuals share this weight.

lateral_weight.description: Weight on the squared cross-track residual. Must be >= 0. Default 1.

longitudinal_weight.description: Weight on the squared along-track residual. Must be >= 0. Default 1.

position.description: Two distinct state indexes of the plane the path is written in. Example: [0, 1].

path_frame.description: Along-track, cross-track, and heading residuals. Omit for none.

zones.description: Slack bands, at most 8. Each band is two inequalities and one slack.

items.description: One slack band. Inside the band the residual is zero.

center.description: Band center, in that state's units.

half_width.description: Half width of the band. Must be >= 0.

state.description: State index this band applies to.

weight.description: Quadratic weight on the band slack. Zero leaves the band unpaid. Must be >= 0.

costs.description: Optional path-frame and zone least-squares residuals. Omit for the quadratic cost only. Needs the nonlinear solver when a path frame or a zone is set.

d_forecast.description: Disturbance forecast, shape N by nd. Omit for a zero forecast.

d_hat.description: Constant disturbance estimate, length nd. Omit for zeros.

enable_disturbance_observer.description: When true, a lightweight observer estimates a constant state bias and the MPC predicts x+ = f(x, u) + d_hat. Default false leaves the NLP unchanged.

enable_stamped_cmd_vel.description: ROS 2 export only. False publishes geometry_msgs/Twist. True publishes TwistStamped. The solve is unchanged.

linear_input_cost.description: Economic stage price on each input node, length nu. Linear, not squared. Omit for zeros.

linear_state_cost.description: Economic stage price on each state node, length nx. Linear, not squared. Omit for zeros.

max_fallback_steps.description: ROS 2 export only. Infeasible solves hold the last command for this many ticks, then publish zero and clear the delay buffer and disturbance estimate.

max_iter.description: IPOPT iteration cap. Default 200, must be >= 1 and <= 500.

observer_clip.description: Per-state saturation on d_hat, length nx, or one number used for every state. Omit for a small default so a bad odometry sample cannot wind the estimate up.

observer_gain.description: Observer blend, clamped to 0.05..0.6. 0.25 is a slow bias tracker.

obstacles.description: Up to 8 circular keep-out zones in the x-y plane. Empty adds no obstacle slacks. Each zone is softened so a start inside the circle does not make IPOPT infeasible.

items.description: One circular keep-out in the plant x-y plane. States 0 and 1 are the plane.

margin.description: Extra clearance added to the radius. Omit for 0.

x.description: Center x, in the same units as state 0.

y.description: Center y, in the same units as state 1.

output_weight.description: Weight on the output residual z - z_ref, with z = C x + D u. Shape ny by ny. Omit for a zero weight, which leaves the quadratic cost on x and u unchanged.

qf_source.description: Terminal weight source. caller uses Qf as sent. discrete_riccati replaces Qf with the discrete algebraic Riccati solution of (A, B, Q, R) on a linear plant.

reset_warm_start.description: Drop this session_id's warm-start seed before the solve. Default false. The compiled solver stays.

scenario_forecasts.description: Disturbance scenarios, each shaped N by nd. Omit for one forecast. One input is shared across the scenarios. Linear plants only.

session_id.description: Reuse this id across solve_mpc calls so the shifted primal and dual warm start stays with this closed loop. Omit it for a stateless solve. Max length 128. The seed is stored for this caller only.

slack_l1.description: L1 penalty on soft state-bound slack. Must be >= 0. Omit for the solver default 1000.

slack_l2.description: L2 penalty on soft state-bound slack. Must be >= 0. Omit for the solver default 100.

solver.description: Leave this at auto. The server selects the numerical method.

system.description: Plant to control. Free validate_problem first, then this paid solve, then autotune if the weights are still unknown.

oneOf.description:
Discrete or continuous linear plant.

Continuous ``(A, B, Bd)`` are converted with a matrix exponential / zero-order
hold at ``dt``. Discrete matrices are used as given. ``Bd`` defaults to ``B``
(input disturbance) when omitted.

A.description: State matrix, shape nx by nx, with nx <= 24. Discrete map or continuous xdot, matching time_mode.

B.description: Input matrix, shape nx by nu, with nu <= 12.

Bd.description: Disturbance matrix, shape nx by nd, with nd <= 12. Omit to reuse B as an input disturbance.

C.description: Output matrix, shape ny by nx. Omit for identity, which uses the full state.

D.description: Feedthrough matrix, shape ny by nu. Omit when there is no direct term.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1. Values above 100 are rejected.

dt.description: Sample time. Must be > 0. Continuous plants are zero-order-hold discretized at this step. Use seconds unless A is written in another time unit.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "linear" for matrices A and B.

time_mode.description: discrete uses A and B as given. continuous is zero-order-hold discretized at dt. Default discrete.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

oneOf.description: Registered dynamics template plus a validated parameter dictionary.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1 and <= 100.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "nonlinear" for a registered template.

name.description: Registered template: double_integrator, thermal_rc_zone, soil_moisture_cascade, unicycle_kinematics, gravity_tank, cart_pendulum, icr_skid_steer, ackermann, quadrotor_3d, thermal_valve_process, marine_usv, anti_sway_crane, process_valve, or quadrotor.

parameters.description: Template knobs, one number per required key. double_integrator and unicycle_kinematics: dt > 0 (seconds). thermal_rc_zone: dt > 0, capacity > 0, time_constant > 0, and ambient. soil_moisture_cascade: dt > 0, capacity > 0, tau_1 > 0, tau_2 > 0, tau_3 > 0, k_12 >= 0, k_23 >= 0. gravity_tank: dt > 0, discharge > 0, inflow_gain > 0. cart_pendulum: dt, cart_mass, pole_mass, friction, inertia, gravity, and length, each > 0. icr_skid_steer: dt > 0 and slip, a signed length with abs(slip) <= 10. Body-frame lateral velocity equals slip * yaw_rate. If x_icr is the forward coordinate of the instantaneous center, positive ahead of the reference point, slip = -x_icr. ackermann: dt > 0 and wheelbase > 0. The steer component of u_min and u_max must lie inside ±1.2 rad. quadrotor_3d: dt from 0.02 to 0.05 s (20–50 Hz outer loop), gravity > 0, and drag >= 0. Inputs are roll, pitch, and thrust acceleration. Tilt bounds stay inside ±0.45 rad. Thrust bounds stay inside 0.4 g to 2 g. thermal_valve_process: dt > 0, rangeability > 1, flow_max > 0, tau_valve > 0, capacity > 0, loss >= 0, ambient, and heater_gain > 0. Valve flow is R^(valve_pos - 1). marine_usv: dt > 0, mass > 0, inertia > 0. Added mass and quadratic drag coefficients are >= 0. anti_sway_crane: dt > 0, cable_length > 0, cart_mass > 0, load_mass > 0, gravity > 0, damping >= 0. The input is cart force. Sway angle limits are soft state bounds. process_valve: dt > 0, capacitance > 0, tau > 0, cv > 0, and supply > 0. quadrotor: dt > 0, mass > 0, gravity > 0, and attitude_tau > 0. Unknown keys are rejected.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

oneOf.description:
Allowlisted scalar expressions, one per state row.

``time_mode`` ``continuous`` is integrated with classical RK4 at ``dt``.
``discrete`` means each expression is already the next state. ``p`` is a
numeric parameter vector baked into the discrete map. ``nd`` may be 0.
Declaring ``nd >= 1`` and never using ``d[i]`` is accepted; detectability
is then false because the disturbance columns of the discrete Jacobian are zero.

C.description: Output matrix, shape ny by nx, with ny <= 8. Omit for identity.

N.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Must be >= 1 and <= 60.

dt.description: Sample time. Must be > 0. Continuous plants are zero-order-hold discretized at this step. Use seconds unless A is written in another time unit.

du_max.description: Upper slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

du_min.description: Lower slew bounds on delta-u, length nu. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Slew bounds are hard.

f.description: One scalar expression per state, length nx. Each string is at most 512 characters and the set is at most 4096. Symbols are x[i], u[i], d[i], p[i], pi, and the smooth allowlist sin, cos, tan, atan, atan2, exp, log, tanh, sqrt, hypot, sq, plus + - * / and ^2 ^3 ^4.

kind.description: Plant kind. Must be "expression" for allowlisted scalar expressions.

nd.description: Disturbance dimension. Must be >= 0 and <= 4. Zero is a plant with no disturbance channel. An unused d[i] when nd is positive does not change the map and reports detectable false.

p.description: Numeric parameter values, length np. Baked into the discrete map.

time_mode.description: continuous integrates the expressions with classical RK4 at dt. discrete uses each expression as the next state. Default continuous.

u_max.description: Upper input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for 1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

u_min.description: Lower input bounds, length nu, in the plant's input units. Omit for -1e6 on each input. Input bounds are hard.

x_max.description: Upper state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for 1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

x_min.description: Lower state bounds, length nx, in the plant's state units. Omit for -1e6 on each state. State bounds are soft.

timeout_s.description: IPOPT wall-clock budget in seconds. Default 2, must be > 0 and <= 5.

tube_bound.description: Elementwise magnitude of an additive state disturbance for tube tightening. Length nx. Omit to leave the bounds unchanged. Linear plants only.

u_prev.description: Previous applied input, length nu, used by the slew penalty. Omit for zeros.

x0.description: Initial state, length nx, at most 24 entries, in the plant's state units.

x_ref.description: Constant state reference, length nx, at most 24 entries. Ignored for the trajectory when X_ref is set.

z_ref.description: Output reference, length ny, held at every stage. Omit for zeros.

name: solve_mpc
title: Solve MPC
